title: 第021章 众心暖护琴姬愈，岭外凶锋暗蓄潮
content_zh:
蔡文姬靠在冰冷的门板上，缓了好半天才直起身。

    她抬手抹去额角沁出的冷汗，在梦奇搀扶下，脚步虚浮地走到院中石桌旁坐下。

    连日来马不停蹄地奔波施法，加上三次被魔渊浊气反噬。

    她体内的灵气早已枯竭，神魂也带着难以言喻的疲惫。

    就连平日里运转自如的胡笳仙骨，此刻都变得有些滞涩。

    她盘膝坐好，闭上眼睛，开始运转体内仅存的音律灵气调息。

    梦奇也乖乖地蹲在她的身边，张开小嘴，轻轻吸走她体内散逸出来的最后一丝残留魔气。

    它还在周围布下了一层薄薄的梦境屏障，隔绝了外界的声音，让蔡文姬能安心调息。

    源源不断的功德之力，依旧在缓缓从天地间汇聚而来。

    其中大半都自动化作修复之力，修补着她受损的经脉与神魂。

    剩下的小部分，则沉淀在胡笳仙骨之中，慢慢滋养着琴骨本源。

    蔡文姬凝神内视。

    只见体内经脉之上，还残留着几缕极淡的黑色纹路。

    那是魔渊浊气留下的印记，短时间内难以彻底根除。

    每一次催动净化之力，这些印记便会隐隐作痛，加剧灵气消耗。

    这便是音律功德道最残酷的代价。

    渡人者，必先承其重。

    净化他人身上的邪祟与浊气，自身便要承担相应的反噬。

    她轻轻叹了口气，没有太过在意。

    只要能护得一方百姓安宁，这点代价算不得什么。

    不知过了多久，院门外传来了轻轻的敲门声。

    “蔡师妹，你在吗？”

    一个清脆的女声响起，带着小心翼翼的关切。

    梦奇立刻竖起耳朵，警惕地看向院门，小声说道：“文姬文姬，是几个漂亮的小姐姐。”

    蔡文姬睁开双眼，轻声应道：“进来吧。”

    院门被轻轻推开。

    几名外门女弟子提着食盒，捧着灵果，小心翼翼地走了进来。

    为首的是平日里常来找她调理经脉的林师妹。

    看到蔡文姬苍白的脸色，林师妹脸上立刻露出心疼的神色。

    “蔡师妹，我们听说你回来了。”

    “特意去膳堂给你熬了补气的莲子羹，还摘了些后山的灵果。”

    “你快尝尝，补补身子。”

    其他几名弟子也纷纷将手里的东西放在石桌上。

    “蔡师妹，这是我娘给我寄来的红枣，最补气血了。”

    “这是我攒的凝神草，泡水喝能安神定魂。”

    “你为了救山下百姓受了这么重的伤，一定要好好休养。”
content_en:
Cai Wenji leaned against the cold door and waited for a long time before she straightened up.

    She raised her hand to wipe away the cold sweat on her forehead, and with Mengqi's support, she walked to the stone table in the courtyard and sat down.

    In the past few days, he had been running around casting spells non-stop, and he had been counterattacked by the turbid energy of the demonic abyss three times.

    The spiritual energy in her body has long been exhausted, and her soul is also filled with indescribable fatigue.

    Even the Hujia Immortal Bones, which usually functioned freely, became a little stagnant at this moment.

    She sat cross-legged, closed her eyes, and began to regulate her breathing with the remaining musical energy in her body.

    Meng Qi also squatted beside her obediently, opened her small mouth, and gently sucked away the last trace of residual evil energy escaping from her body.

    It also lays a thin dream barrier around it, blocking out sounds from the outside world, allowing Cai Wenji to adjust her breathing with peace of mind.

    A steady stream of merit power is still slowly gathering from heaven and earth.

    Most of them have automatic repair power, repairing her damaged meridians and soul.

    The remaining small part is deposited in the Hujia Immortal Bone, slowly nourishing the origin of the piano bone.

    Cai Wenji looked inside intently.

    I could see that there were still a few very faint black lines remaining on the meridians in the body.

    That is the mark left by the turbid energy of the Demonic Abyss, and it is difficult to completely eradicate it in a short period of time.

    Every time the power of purification is activated, these marks will ache, aggravating the consumption of spiritual energy.

    This is the cruelest price of music and virtue.

    Those who ferry people must bear their weight first.

    To purify the evil spirits and turbidity in others, you will have to bear the corresponding backlash.

    She sighed softly and didn't pay too much attention.

    As long as one can protect the peace of the people, this price is nothing.

    After an unknown amount of time, there was a gentle knock on the door.

    "Junior Sister Cai, are you there?"

    A clear female voice sounded, with careful concern.

    Meng Qi immediately pricked up his ears, looked at the courtyard door warily, and whispered: "Wenji Wenji, they are some beautiful ladies."

    Cai Wenji opened her eyes and responded softly: "Come in."

    The courtyard door was gently pushed open.

    Several female disciples from the outer sect walked in cautiously, carrying food boxes and spiritual fruits.

    The leader was Junior Sister Lin who often came to her to regulate her meridians.

    Seeing Cai Wenji's pale face, Junior Sister Lin immediately showed a distressed look on her face.

    "Junior sister Cai, we heard that you are back."

    "I went to the dining hall specially to make you a lotus seed soup to replenish your energy, and also picked some spiritual fruits from the back mountain."

    "Try it quickly to replenish your health."

    Several other disciples also placed the things in their hands on the stone table.

    "Junior sister Cai, these are the red dates my mother sent me. They are the best for replenishing qi and blood."

    "This is the concentration grass I saved. Soak it in water and drink it to calm your mind and soul."

    "You were so seriously injured trying to save the people at the foot of the mountain. You must take a good rest."
title_en: Chapter 021: The warm hearts of the people protect Qin Ji’s recovery, and the fierce front outside the mountain is secretly gathering momentum.
